dialogue_texts: Yukari
Since Koakuma didn't help me, I locked her in the library with so much enthusiasm.
Who are you looking for?
Yukari
The person I need to see is Flandre, who may be orchestrating the glohm.
Yukari
She's trying to take souls and make them her slaves!
The Scarlet Devil isn't looking to speak with anyone at the moment.
More importantly, I'm looking for the one who assassinated my husband nine months ago.
Yukari
Vladrouge was a rather messy person who didn't need an invitation to walk through a wall.
Yukari
Is that who you're talking about?
Camille
Correct. I am his wife and the mother of Remilia and Flandre Scarlet.
Camille
My grunts are hoping to bring vengeance over the love of my life.
Yukari
Flandre is the one I'm looking for. Please tell me where she is.
Camille
I think that if you're who I think you are, I won't tell you where Flandre is. She is not in the mansion right now.
Yukari
Looks like you've just revealed quite a lot with your tongue.
Camille
I'm afraid I can't tell you.
Yukari
There's no "afraid" when it comes to the truth.
Yukari
You need to fill that void, and you seem to have forgotten that I'm the one who stitches reality together.
Camille
You speak of my daughters as if they are mere subjects to be managed.
Camille
Perhaps you've forgotten your place, whoever the heck you are.
Yukari
It seems the glohm has dulled your perception.
Yukari
Queen Yukari is the one who will show you that the Order's architecture is built on a foundation of sand.
Camille
Then let me see if your skills match your arrogance.
Camille
If you want the truth, you'll have to earn it.
